invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破0.092（ATR支撑），或资金费率Z-score转正（空头压力缓解）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 0.092 (ATR support), or funding Z-score turns positive (short pressure eases).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破2080（支撑位），或资金费率Z-score回升至-20%以上（轧空动力消失）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 2080 (support level), or funding Z-score rises above -20% (short squeeze momentum fades).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破85（基于ATR支撑），或融资费率Z-score升至100%以上（轧多风险增加）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 85 (based on ATR support), or funding Z-score rises above 100% (long squeeze risk increases).
